scope: Source-owned SocialBox presentation over retained compiled core. Static inventories do not establish runtime reachability or full visual coverage.

fixedCopyCatalog.mechanism: Only SB_LEGACY-marked input strings may contain legacy display literals. Output copy and source UI remain owned.

roleContract.Fixed: Exact reviewed fixed copy; unknown text unchanged.
roleContract.Status: Reviewed fixed/templates; unknown legacy product/support status uses neutral text and stable short SHA-256 reference. Ordinary status remains unchanged.
roleContract.Diagnostic: Known fixed errors and reviewed safe helper causes; all unrecognized diagnostics use neutral text and stable short SHA-256 reference. No raw logging, URLs, credentials or arbitrary suffix reflection.
roleContract.UserData: Always unchanged, including a value exactly matching a legacy product word or fixed-copy key.
roleContract.Apply: Only explicitly role-marked labels are eligible; unmarked labels, user controls, fields and navigation titles are untouched.
roleContract.OriginalAlerts: Default adapter maps reviewed fixed/templates only. Diagnostic context is limited to the exact Cloud, CloudPush and license showError: entrypoints; prior per-owner nesting state is restored on return and exception. Both adapters preserve original action objects, callbacks, enabled state, style, preferred action, fields and delegates. No alert-title guessing.
roleContract.SourceActions: LBXDisplayActionTitle maps only source-created fixed titles. It cannot rename an existing readonly UIAlertAction.title.

limits: Original binary and metadata read only; no imported executable was run.
Binary results contain offsets, hashes and classifications, not raw runtime/user content.
Obfuscated strings, server responses, web content and all future runtime messages cannot be proven covered by static string extraction.
A candidate binary match is not proof of UI reachability.
Raw legacy input is preserved in the compatibility catalog and original core; the source guard is not a whole-binary zero-string claim.

guard.scope: Every top-level .m/.h in lucid/Presentation, matching production translation-unit layout
guard.exemptions: Exact ABI literals in enumerated files; SB_LEGACY-marked catalog inputs; synthetic Tests directory is nonproduction. No blanket exemption for an entire UI implementation.
